palaris.name: Codex
palaris.scope: Do bounded work items inside declared write boundaries.

palaris.name: Independent Reviewer
palaris.scope: Inspect exact current proof in review mode without editing task outputs or granting human approval.

work_items.title: Make Palari use plain product language
work_items.scope: Replace unnecessary public governance jargon with task, run, checks, review, approval, result, and history language across documentation and operator-facing CLI surfaces while preserving exact machine contracts.
forbidden_actions: write outside the declared write paths
work_items.acceptance_target: A new user can understand Palari without architecture jargon; ordinary help, status, and guidance use the approved plain vocabulary; stored JSON, schema keys, status values, IDs, PCAW v1, journal records, and security meaning remain compatible; focused and complete verification pass.
verification_expectations: Focused documentation, CLI, read-model, agent-presentation, and public-surface tests pass.
JSON keys, status values, schema, PCAW v1, and journal compatibility remain unchanged.
./scripts/verify.sh complete passes once on the final candidate.
work_items.terminal_reason: The task boundary omitted scripts/make_demo_assets.sh, which was inspected during asset consistency review. No out-of-boundary file was changed; the successor records the corrected boundary and owns the complete candidate.

work_items.title: Finish the plain-language product migration
work_items.scope: Audit and complete the approved vocabulary migration across public documentation, generated guidance, operator-facing CLI and MCP text, the local human view, demo generator, and tests. Preserve exact commands, flags, JSON keys, stored values, IDs, schemas, PCAW, journals, Approval Packs, and hashed session-contract bytes.
forbidden_actions: write outside the declared write paths
work_items.acceptance_target: A new user sees task, project, run, task brief, task lock, run record, checks, review, approval, result, and six plain statuses across ordinary surfaces; generated assets match; machine contracts remain compatible; focused and complete verification pass.
verification_expectations: python3 -m unittest tests.test_plain_language tests.test_docs tests.test_cli_smoke tests.test_mcp_server tests.test_mission_control tests.test_demo

work_items.title: Give each agent a persistent home
work_items.scope: Add one read-only agent home organized recursively under Memory, Initiative, and Control.
forbidden_actions: write outside the declared write paths
work_items.acceptance_target: palari agent home presents persistent context, current initiative, and human control without requiring a task id; JSON shape and text output are tested and documented.
verification_expectations: Focused agent-home and public-surface tests pass.

work_items.title: Give the whole repo one simple tree
work_items.scope: Replace the local three-part agent view with one plain five-part product view and add a checked tree that places every tracked repo file in one non-overlapping branch.
forbidden_actions: write outside the declared write paths
work_items.acceptance_target: Every tracked repo file belongs to exactly one checked branch; every branch has zero or three to five child parts; new public names are plain; agent home uses Goals, Team, Work, Checks, and Limits; focused and full checks pass.
verification_expectations: The repo tree check proves full tracked-file coverage, no overlap, and the three-to-five child rule.

work_items.title: Let agents add safe work ideas
work_items.scope: Add an agent-created idea mode to work add; ideas grant no authority, and only a human may approve one into a task.
forbidden_actions: write outside the declared write paths
work_items.acceptance_target: Agents can add bounded ideas, human approval creates an equivalent task, direct task creation remains compatible, and all checks pass.

work_items.title: Let agents add safe work ideas
work_items.scope: Add an agent-created idea mode to work add; ideas grant no authority, and only a human may approve one into a task. This successor corrects the stored-link validation boundary.
forbidden_actions: write outside the declared write paths
work_items.acceptance_target: Agents can add bounded ideas, human approval creates an equivalent task, direct task creation remains compatible, and all checks pass.
